req.title: Retrieve player by ID
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/{playerId} with the corresponding player object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /players/{playerId} returning HTTP 200 with a matching Player object. I designed tests covering: (1) EP positive — retrieve a known player by UUID and assert every field exactly; (2) NEG negative — request a well-formed UUID that does not exist in the DB and assert HTTP 404; (3) BVA boundary — supply a malformed/non-UUID path segment and assert HTTP 422 (FastAPI path validation); (4) DT decision-table — verify the response body fields match the seeded fixture row exactly, catching field-mapping mutations; (5) BVA boundary — use the first seeded UUID (squad 1) and last seeded UUID (squad 26) to probe the extremes of the dataset. All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_known_player_returns_200_and_exact_body
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
expected: Response JSON matches every field of the Messi fixture row exactly
trace: R-PLAYER-002: system shall respond with HTTP 200 and matching Player object
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_known_player_returns_200_and_exact_body():
    player_id = 'acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == player_id
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Lionel'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Andrés'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'RW'
    assert body['team'] == 'Paris Saint-Germain'
    assert body['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert body['starting11'] == True

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_response_contains_all_required_keys():
    player_id = '01772c59-43f0-5d85-b913-c78e4e281452'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    expected_keys = {'id', 'firstName', 'middleName', 'lastName', 'dateOfBirth',
                     'squadNumber', 'position', 'abbrPosition', 'team', 'league', 'starting11'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == expected_keys
    assert body['id'] == player_id
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Damián'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Emiliano'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Martínez'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 23
    assert body['position'] == 'Goalkeeper'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'GK'
    assert body['team'] == 'Aston Villa FC'
    assert body['league'] == 'Premier League'
    assert body['starting11'] == True
